description: L1 meta gate: each child acceptance maps to a real test. FULL_IMPLEMENT must append entries for the parent being delivered. Empty entries is valid only when META_PARENT=pure-chore (PR body: <!-- hither-test-meta parent: pure-chore -->). Required parent ids fail L1 if zero matching entries.
